geometric_error_rule: Match I left vertical unit edge to II long oblique edge by their one-row rise, and pair the other genuine vertical unit edges. Proposed error ignores II Δx2 and copies length1 to its sqrt5 edge. The two unchanged sqrt2 sides then give identical perimeter as well as equal area, C.
material_difference: Old v01 colored both whole quadrilateral contours red; presetC, finalsE/E. New four selective existing-edge marks encode a specific one-row-rise-versus-Euclidean-length error with a true unit pair as calibration; diagonal families remain black. This is a structural grouping change, not mere palette/width replacement.

primary_math_proof.derivation: I is a parallelogram with unit vertical base and unit horizontal separation, area1. II ordered(2,1),(4,2),(3,1),(3,0) has shoelace area1. I side lengths sqrt2,1,sqrt2,1. II side lengths sqrt5,sqrt2,1,sqrt2. Thus equal area and smaller perimeter I, uniquely E. In particular the red II side has Δx2,Δy1 and lengthsqrt5 even though it spans one vertical row.

per_marker_roles.role: I left actual vertical unit edge: one-row-rise unit source.
II long oblique edge with Δx2,Δy1,lengthsqrt5: receiver of false rise-to-length correspondence.
I right actual vertical unit edge: genuine calibration-pair source.
II actual vertical unit edge: true unit counterpart; remaining two sqrt2 sides in each figure stay black.

human_semantics: Numerical metric/area comparison. Colors on existing edges or allowed auxiliary lines do not become explicit equality, length, fill or count conditions. Primary native visual review still required before calls.
